subject: general
question: Which of the following automobile companies announced its decision to stop manufacturing vehicles for sale in India in September 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ford Motor Company.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ford Motor Company **announced its decision to stop manufacturing vehicles for sale in India in September 2021.
 
• After nearly **three decades **of struggling to make a mark in India, **Ford Motor Co on September 9** announced that it would stop vehicle production at its two plants in the country and will sell only imported vehicles going ahead as part of a restructuring exercise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ford Motor Company** is an American multinational automobile manufacturer headquartered in** Dearborn, Michigan, United States.**
 
• It was founded by Henry Ford and incorporated on **June 16, 1903.**
 
• The company sells automobiles and commercial vehicles under the Ford brand, and luxury cars under its** Lincoln luxury brand. **
